summary: Closed O1' on the structured subclass H_beta with finite-degree polynomial constraints: exact decision criterion is closure(span Q_sp)=V iff ker(T|_{B_adm})={0}, where T is the finite membership matrix on admissible free bases and admissible means finite run or beta>3/2 for infinite runs; coordinate Theorem E is recovered; explicit non-coordinate finite free-base obstruction example is included.
